definitions.explanation: Paper used to wrap gifts or products. In Japan, stores typically offer wrapping paper for purchases that are intended as gifts.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{包装紙|ほうそうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}んだ→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: I wrapped the present in wrapping paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な{包装紙|ほうそうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose a nice wrapping paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{百貨店|ひゃっかてん}→百貨店：18639_hyakkaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{包装紙|ほうそうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: At department stores, they wrap your purchases in wrapping paper for free.

notes:
Paper used to wrap gifts or purchases. In Japanese culture, presentation matters greatly, and wrapping is considered part of the gift.

FORMS:
⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧ (wrapping, packaging) + {紙|し} (paper).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to wrap in wrapping paper
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to tear open wrapping paper
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose wrapping paper

CULTURAL NOTE:
Department stores (⟦{百貨店|ひゃっかてん}→百貨店：18639_hyakkaten⟧) and specialty shops typically offer free gift-wrapping. Each store often has its own signature {包装紙|ほうそうし}, which can signal where the gift was purchased.
